_why_excluded: Five flash rows failed the gate on LANDING, and the gate was right each time: the pop is off camera or cut away from. No frame shows the deploy, so no override can repair them.

excluded.58: LANDING: the flash pops above the hallway ceiling-beam lip at the top edge of frame. The only deploy evidence is a small starburst at 69.2 (frames.sh y_k04l.png, 68.6-69.8, frame-exact), and by 69.3 the player turns to walk. There is no bloom and no whiteout, and nothing else at the landing can be cut. The gate failed LANDING on it for the same reason.
excluded.154: LANDING: the author cuts to a different POV (Mid Catwalk, facing a wall) before the pop. A dense 60fps pass from the release to +3s finds no bloom, no whiteout and no lighting wash in the thrower's POV.
excluded.200: LANDING: the flash pops behind the building roofline while the thrower walks toward the wall without looking. The only evidence is a small glint at the top-left of the wall at 209.9 (frames.sh y_k13l.png, 209.3-210.6, frame-exact). By 210.4 the view is pressed against the wall.
excluded.307: LANDING: the deploy is never on camera. The canister climbs over the overhang lip and the next shot is a different ground-level courtyard scene with the rifle out.
excluded.336: LANDING: the detonation is hidden behind the B-site crate. There is no bloom and no whiteout from the thrower's POV, and nothing else at the landing can be cut.
